'''Crawler vines''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Vine/Legends|vine]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Phontos]] kept potted crawler vines in his office on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
